{{ElectionsNM}}

The '''2026 New Mexico gubernatorial election''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[governor of New Mexico]]. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] former U.S. Secretary of the Interior [[Deb Haaland]] and [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Rio Rancho Mayor [[Gregg Hull]] are the nominees for their respective parties. Democratic incumbent [[Michelle Lujan Grisham]] is [[Term limits in the United States|term limited]] and ineligible to seek a third consecutive term. 

[[Primary elections]] took place on June 2. Haaland defeated [[Bernalillo County, New Mexico|Bernalillo County]] district attorney Sam Bergman in the Democratic primary with 72% of the vote. Hull defeated Doug Turner and Duke Rodriguez in the Republican primary with 47% of the vote.

==Democratic primary==
===Governor===

====Replacement selection====
After winning the June 2 primary, Toulouse Oliver withdrew from the race on June 18, citing health issues. Haaland announced she would be interviewing candidates to replace Toulouse Oliver on the ballot.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kob.com/new-mexico/deb-haaland-wants-to-interview-candidates-for-lieutenant-governor/|title=Deb Haaland wants to interview candidates for lieutenant governor|first=Robert|last=Towne|date=June 23, 2026|work=[[KOB (TV)|KOB]]}}</ref> However, the final decision on Toulouse Oliver's replacement rested with the state Democratic Party's Central Committee.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kob.com/new-mexico/this-is-kind-of-a-whole-new-ballgame-haaland-announces-own-lieutenant-governor-search-process/|title='This is kind of a whole new ballgame': Haaland announces own lieutenant governor search process|first=Monica|last=Logroño|date=June 24, 2026|work=[[KOB (TV)|KOB]]}}</ref> The candidates listed below are the five Haaland chose to interview, though the State Central Committee could have chosen any candidate and was not limited to the following five. Haaland endorsed Garcia Richard on June 26,<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.kob.com/new-mexico/deb-haaland-endorses-stephanie-garcia-richard-for-new-mexico-lieutenant-governor/|title=Deb Haaland endorses Stephanie Garcia Richard for New Mexico lieutenant governor|first=Mesha|last=Begay|date=June 27, 2026|work=[[KOB (TV)|KOB]]}}</ref> and the State Central Committee formally chose her on July 30.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kob.com/news/top-news/stephanie-garcia-richard-wins-democratic-lieutenant-governor-nomination/|title=Stephanie Garcia Richard wins Democratic lieutenant governor nomination|first=Jonathan |last=Fjeld|date=July 30, 2026|work=[[KOB (TV)|KOB]]}}</ref>

=====Replacement nominee=====
*[[Stephanie Garcia Richard]], [[New Mexico Commissioner of Public Lands]] (2019–present)

=====Eliminated in replacement vote=====
*[[Leo Jaramillo]], [[New Mexico Senate|state senator]] from the 5th district (2021–present)
*[[Harold Pope Jr.]], [[New Mexico Senate|state senator]] from the 23rd district (2021–present) and runner-up in the original primary election
*Antonia Roybal-Mack, attorney
*Sonia Smith, former New Mexico Secretary of Veterans Services<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.kob.com/news/top-news/haaland-to-meet-with-5-democratic-lieutenant-governor-candidates/|title=Haaland to meet with 5 Democratic lieutenant governor candidates|first=Jonathan|last=Fjeld|date=June 26, 2026|work=[[KOB (TV)|KOB]]}}</ref>
